rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved courses or activities only (contact hour = 60 minutes; minimum 1 hour). APTA, Louisiana PTA and Louisiana CAPTE-program courses meeting the content criteria are automatically approved; other courses are approved on sponsor or individual licensee application (not in the last 60 days of the license term). Also: teaching an approved course (2 h per contact hour, max 10), ABPTS initial certification (10 h), residency/fellowship (1 h per 2 h, max 10), postgraduate/tDPT coursework with grade B or higher (1 semester hour = 10 h), teaching in a CAPTE program (max 10), board-approved self-assessment tool (6 h), elected/appointed PT organization positions (max 5), clinical instructor/mentor (1 h per 120 h, max 5), publications and posters (max 5), Board Healthy Practice modules (1 h per 2 modules).
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt for the CE year (April 1 - March 31) in which the licensee graduated; 15 contact hours for the second year of the renewal period.
rules.audit_note: Hours are reported to the Board with the renewal application on Board forms/the licensee dashboard; keep records 4 years after the program date. Random audit each renewal period.

topics.who: Passing the online jurisprudence examination or attending a Board-sponsored jurisprudence course fulfils the 2 hours

rules.legal_basis: La. Admin. Code tit. 46, pt. LIV, §§179-199
rules.notes: 30 hours per biennial renewal period = at least 2 jurisprudence + 2 ethics/professionalism + 26 clinical and/or administrative. Licenses run one or two years at first issue depending on birth year, then biennially; licenses expire April 30, renewal due by March 31 (late fee April 1-30). The CE year runs April 1 - March 31.
rules.rule_quote: Unless exempted under §198, licensees shall successfully complete, document and report to the board at least 30 hours of board–approved continuing education courses or activities in the biennial renewal period.
